races.paceDynamic: Pleasant Man and Further Measure are the only two horses with prominent/leading tendencies in this nine-runner field, setting up a sustainable pace scenario over this extended trip. With seven hold-up horses including in-form Hengest, King's Castle, and Big Bear Hug, the majority will be looking to make their move from off the pace in the final 3-4 furlongs. The lack of early pace pressure means Pleasant Man can dictate terms without being harassed, while the prominent runners can position themselves ideally. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners and patient front-runners who can control the tempo and have enough left for the finish.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Pace Suits Leaders
scenarios.trigger: If Pleasant Man or Further Measure can dictate a steady tempo without pressure
scenarios.body: The pace-setters get an easy lead and have enough left to repel the late challengers over this stamina-sapping trip. Hold-up horses leave themselves too much to do against horses who've conserved energy up front.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up horses Rally Late
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes genuinely slow and bunched
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace allows the better-quality hold-up horses to unleash decisive finishing kicks in the final 2f. Class tells as Hengest and King's Castle benefit from their recent good form.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Stamina Test Favourites
scenarios.trigger: If the pace quickens significantly from halfway and becomes a true test
scenarios.body: The extended distance becomes the deciding factor as the most proven stayers come to the fore. Further Measure's recent 2m form and King's Castle's staying ability prove decisive.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Package Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the main fancies fail to handle the conditions or trip
scenarios.body: One of the less-fancied runners with a suitable profile benefits from the pace collapse. Atlantic Sunset or Big Bear Hug capitalize on a messy race.

watchPoints.text: Pleasant Man could get an uncontested lead with Further Measure the only other early pace, creating tactical advantage
Hengest's quick turnaround from Windsor win eight days ago - watch for any signs of overexertion or fatigue
King's Castle returning after 218-day layoff - monitor market moves and appearance for fitness clues
Bridge switching from hurdles to flat after recent jumping success - early positioning will reveal intentions
Further Measure dropping back from 2m to this intermediate trip after 84-day break - pace judgment crucial

races.paceDynamic: Spirit Of Albion is the only confirmed front runner in this field and should get an uncontested lead from the break. With most rivals adopting hold-up tactics, the pace will be modest early before quickening from the 3f pole as the closers make their moves. The lack of early pace pressure means Spirit Of Albion can dictate terms and set sustainable fractions. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners and those with early speed who can track the leader, as the hold-up horses will face a difficult task closing from the back in a small field with limited pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Spirit Of Albion gets soft fractions and stays 7f
scenarios.body: He can control the race from pillar to post and prove hard to peg back when the closers finally get going. The modest early pace allows him to save energy for a sustained kick.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Closer Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes crawling and one hold-up horse has superior class
scenarios.body: The field bunches up turning for home creating a sprint finish where raw ability trumps tactical positioning. Vidmiyr's RPR advantage could tell in this scenario.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Spirit Of Albion stops quickly and multiple closers charge late
scenarios.body: The race becomes a cavalry charge in the final furlong with several horses hitting the line together. Track position and jockey skill become crucial.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Early Pace Battle
scenarios.trigger: If other horses challenge Spirit Of Albion early or he misses the break
scenarios.body: The tempo lifts throughout creating end-to-end gallop that suits horses with tactical pace. This opens the door for versatile types.

watchPoints.text: Spirit Of Albion's fitness after 293-day layoff could see him fold in the final furlong despite tactical advantage
Vidmiyr needs the pace to develop early to give his hold-up style a chance from the back
Both debutants Ice To Meet You and Fiefdom could show early speed and disrupt the pace scenario
Malakai Kite's gate issues on debut could resurface and compromise his chances from the start
The 5lb claimer Mason Paetel on Spirit Of Albion adds pressure in what should be his best chance

races.paceDynamic: Weston Court is the sole confirmed front-runner and will dictate from the start, likely setting a sustainable pace without early pressure from the field of 14. Man Is King, Maury, Grand Citadel and Letsbeatsepsis will sit prominently behind the leader, creating a solid midfield group. The majority of the field including Mr Fustic, Mighty Ruler, Up The Anti and Whiteley Way are hold-up horses who will need the pace to develop. This tactical setup strongly favours prominent runners who can position close enough to strike when Weston Court inevitably fades, as the abundance of hold-up horses will create traffic problems in the finish.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Pounce
scenarios.trigger: If Weston Court sets a steady pace and the prominent runners get good position
scenarios.body: Man Is King can utilise his recent winning form to strike from a handy position, while Maury's front-running experience helps him judge the pace perfectly. The hold-up horses get caught in traffic as the prominent brigade control the finish.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Highway
scenarios.trigger: If Weston Court goes too fast early or prominent runners press him into a strong pace
scenarios.body: The pace collapses and creates gaps for the hold-up merchants to exploit with late runs. Mighty Ruler and Mr Fustic benefit from their recent Lingfield experience and strong finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Leader Lasts
scenarios.trigger: If Weston Court gets soft fractions and the field sits too far back
scenarios.body: The lone leader gets an easy time in front and maintains enough energy to resist late challengers. His fading tendencies are negated by the lack of early pressure from this tactical field.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Traffic Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the large field creates severe crowding problems in the straight
scenarios.body: The race becomes a lottery with positioning crucial and several fancied runners getting hampered. Outsiders like Huntly Lodge or Heer's Sadie benefit from cleaner passages.

watchPoints.text: Weston Court must be monitored for early fractions as the only leader in this large field
Traffic problems highly likely in straight with 10+ hold-up horses needing room
Man Is King's recent winning form makes him the one to beat if prominent runners dominate
Letsbeatsepsis returns after 258 days and has shown free-running tendencies previously
Jockey bookings favour the prominent runners with experienced pilots taking those rides

races.paceDynamic: Kev is the only confirmed front runner in this 14-runner handicap and should get an uncontested lead with Dubai Harbour likely tracking in second. The sustainable early pace will allow the large group of hold-up horses including Bear To Dream, The Spotlight Kid, Raqraaq, and Charlatan to get into contention. With 11 of the 14 runners adopting hold-up tactics and only one pace-setter, this race strongly favours prominent racers and forward hold-up horses who can position close enough to strike.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Lead Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Kev gets soft fractions and stays on
scenarios.body: The gentle pace allows him to conserve energy despite his finishing concerns, while the hold-up brigade leave their runs too late. Dubai Harbour can also benefit from the forward position if Kev weakens.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Surge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is even slower than expected
scenarios.body: The patient hold-up horses get the perfect scenario to unleash late runs despite being further back. No Gain's recent Doncaster second shows he can finish strongly in big fields.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Kev Wire-To-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If the opposition fails to close despite favorable circumstances
scenarios.body: His poor recent form and fading tendency make this unlikely, but stranger things have happened when pace-setters get dream runs. The hold-up horses would need to completely misfire.

races.paceDynamic: Lordsbridge Bay is the only confirmed early leader in this field, with Poetic Grace likely to sit prominent but having shown a tendency to fade late. The lack of genuine pace angles means Lordsbridge Bay can dictate terms without pressure through steady fractions. With 11 of 13 runners classified as hold-up horses, the majority will be looking to come from off the pace in what should develop into a sprint finish over the final 2f. This pace scenario strongly favours prominent runners and those with tactical speed who can position close to the pace, as the hold-up brigade will face a traffic-heavy finish with limited time to make up ground.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Lordsbridge Bay gets an easy lead and maintains steady fractions
scenarios.body: The pace-setter can control the race from the front and kick clear when the field fans out, while the mass of hold-up horses struggle to pick up the pieces in time. Front-runners and prominent racers benefit from the tactical advantage and cleaner passage.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuinely slow and allows closers time to wind up
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses get the patient ride they need and can unleash their finishing kicks with the tempo suiting their style perfectly. Those with the best turn of foot from off the pace capitalise on the sitting-up scenario.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Poetic Grace Takes Over
scenarios.trigger: If Poetic Grace shows more early speed than usual and presses Lordsbridge Bay
scenarios.body: The dual pace pressure creates a more honest gallop that sets up the race for mid-division runners who can track the pace without being too far back. This moderate tempo suits horses that can be handy without leading.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Messy Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Lordsbridge Bay goes too slow early then multiple horses make moves simultaneously
scenarios.body: The race becomes a tactical muddle with stop-start fractions causing trouble in running for many, but horses with gate speed who can position handily benefit from avoiding the inevitable trouble behind.

This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses with tactical speed who can produce a late rattle in the final two furlongs.

scenarios.title: Faustus Controls Uncontested
scenarios.trigger: If Faustus gets an easy lead and sustains his kick
scenarios.body: The veteran dictates ideal fractions and kicks clear, while prominent trackers Level Up and Cameley Days pick up the pieces as hold-up horses struggle for room. Faustus benefits from the tempo control while Level Up's recent seconds suggest he's primed to capitalize.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Duo Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Level Up and Cameley Days work in tandem to pressure Faustus
scenarios.body: The prominent pair's superior recent form tells as they hunt down a weakening Faustus, with Level Up's Bath and Nottingham seconds pointing to imminent success. Hold-up horses again find trouble in running on the tight track.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Weaves Through
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses and gaps appear late
scenarios.body: One of the stronger hold-up performers finds a dream passage through the field as Faustus stops quickly. Harry Brown's recent C&D win or Cabeza De Llave's Windsor second give them the form edge if they get racing room.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Traffic Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the field bunches badly turning for home
scenarios.body: The race becomes a lottery with hold-up horses struggling desperately for room while Faustus capitalizes on a muddling pace. An unconsidered runner like Fletcher's Flight could emerge from the chaos if the gaps appear at the right moment.

watchPoints.text: Harry Brown needs significant pace collapse and racing room to repeat his recent C&D success from this higher mark
Fletcher's Flight reared and unseated rider last time out, creating pre-race behavioral concerns for new connections
Teardrops makes turf debut for new trainer having campaigned exclusively on AW, unknown quantity on grass
Faustus must sustain his kick longer than recent efforts suggest he can against this improved field quality
Level Up's recent Bath and Nottingham seconds indicate he's overdue a win and perfectly positioned tactically
